_comment: Illustrative, fully fictional example test cases. They show the shape of the test-case file the skill generates after your first run. Replace with your own product, sources, and recipients. All names and data here are invented (seed-data rule: nothing real in examples).
domain: example: a fictional B2B SaaS product prototyped inside a host app via Apex Bridge

test_cases.prompt: Prototype a Trust Score panel that shows users how an automated confidence score is calculated. Pull from the positioning doc and the scoring-model definition. Show it as an Apex Bridge overlay inside the host application. Directional fidelity (Tier 2) — we're testing whether surfacing the math behind the score builds confidence or just creates cognitive load. Run council and watch for JTBD vs. Service Blueprint disagreeing on how much math to expose.
expected_outputs: scout_input/ with 2-3 source docs
briefs/trust-score.brief.md with 40-60% [A]+[?] ratio (appropriate for Tier 2)
critic-pass-1.md with pre-build scores
prototypes/trust-score/index.html with the Apex Bridge overlay, Tier 2 fidelity banner, review rail
critic-pass-2.md with post-build scores + delta table
council-testimony.md with JTBD and Service Blueprint potentially contradicting on math visibility
briefs/handoffs/[recipient]-trust-score-[date]/ with complete packet
success_criteria: Apex Bridge overlay renders correctly (slide-in from right or modal)
review rail Product card shows attribution percentage with reasoning
Council explicitly names a transparency tension (if present)
[A]+[?] ratio is in the Tier 2 band
Handoff packet includes an attribution matrix for the Product card
test_cases.notes: If the recipient authored the source docs, keep tone peer-to-peer and don't re-explain concepts they already own.

test_cases.prompt: Show me what a monthly Usage Ledger could look like when a customer reviews their usage and cost breakdown. Concept-level (Tier 1) — exploratory, so a high [A] ratio is expected. Run full council to see whether JTBD and Value Chain agree on whether to show the cost math or hide it.
expected_outputs: scout_input/ with any provided context docs
briefs/usage-ledger.brief.md with 50-70% [A]+[?] ratio (appropriate for Tier 1)
critic-pass-1.md flagging the high [A] ratio but noting it's appropriate for Tier 1
prototypes/usage-ledger/index.html with an Apex Bridge overlay and a Tier 1 fidelity banner
critic-pass-2.md with post-build scores
council-testimony.md with voices potentially contradicting on transparency
briefs/handoffs/[recipient]-usage-ledger-[date]/ routing the visibility decision to the recipient
success_criteria: Spec explicitly flags the high [A]+[?] ratio but proceeds (appropriate for Tier 1)
Council runs the full voice set, not just the two expected
Any contradiction on visibility is routed as a decision to the recipient, not resolved by the tool
review rail includes 'Unknown: gap' in the ROI section where data is missing
test_cases.notes: Tier 1 / Concept means exploration is the goal. High [A] ratio is expected and should not block. Here the expert council is the primary deliverable.

test_cases.prompt: Prototype the escalation screen where a customer hands off from the automated assistant to a human expert. Spec-ready (Tier 3), so [A] ratio should be under 30%. Show what context the human expert sees on receiving the handoff. Use an Apex Bridge overlay. Include ownership attribution on any AI-generated elements.
expected_outputs: scout_input/ with the relevant source docs
briefs/human-handoff.brief.md with <30% [A]+[?] ratio (Tier 3 requirement)
critic-pass-1.md noting whether the spec meets the Tier 3 threshold
prototypes/human-handoff/index.html with context-transfer UI, the Apex Bridge overlay, Tier 3 banner, attribution on AI-generated elements
critic-pass-2.md validating that attribution display is present and correct
council-testimony.md with the Service Blueprint voice analyzing the frontstage/backstage handoff
briefs/handoffs/[recipient]-human-handoff-[date]/ with complete packet + attribution matrix
success_criteria: [A]+[?] ratio is <30% OR the spec flags a readiness issue and asks whether to proceed
Prototype shows the context transfer from AI to human clearly
Ownership attribution displays on any AI-generated content (e.g. '0% [recipient]' for a tool-generated summary)
Handoff packet includes an attribution matrix with calculations for multiple components
test_cases.notes: Tier 3 means build-ready. If [A]+[?] exceeds 30%, the spec should flag and confirm before proceeding. Attribution is emphasized here — test that the skill applies and displays X% [recipient] throughout.

validation_notes: Swap in your own sources, product, and recipient — everything above is fictional.
Test cases span Tier 1/2/3 to exercise the readiness-threshold logic at each gate.
All cases include the review rail and council by default.
Attribution emphasis varies by case — the Tier 3 case specifically validates the display.
